evidence_slice: Historic England's official NHLE entry 1306502 identifies Bridge Inn, Bridge Hill, Topsham, Exeter, as a Grade II Listed Building and describes it as an eighteenth-century coaching inn with probable earlier origins. Historic England's current NHLE FeatureServer layer 3 is 'Listed Building polygons', geometry type esriGeometryPolygon, with ListEntry, Name, Grade, CaptureScale and area_ha fields. A distinct single-record GeoJSON request for ListEntry 1306502 was attempted; the web retrieval channel rejected the parameterized query URL and a direct HTTP attempt failed DNS resolution before any feature payload was read.

field_evidence.footprint: Official NHLE layer 3 is esriGeometryPolygon and binds geometry to ListEntry/Name/Grade, but the exact ListEntry 1306502 feature payload was not readable; no coordinates were fabricated.
